title: You set up a disposable mechanic test

steps.text: An origin-local opt-in opens the persistent Dev strip and non-modal dock. Off clears Dev preferences. Without opt-in the tools stay unloaded; friends receive no preference.
The selected panel loads on demand. Free camera owns input independently of the dock and never moves the body. Buttons and the agent API use the same bounded commands.
A fresh solo place run gets its own room, scoped saves and a TEST badge. Travel and stage setup check the exact launched session and refuse shared rooms.
The report records build, setup, poses and command results. Its setup link asks before launching another disposable run; it is not an exact world replay.
